summary: Iteration 2 testing: backend unlock_date/Time Capsule field + frontend rebrand & Time Capsule UI. Backend 100% pass (21/21 incl. 3 new unlock_date tests). Frontend rebrand and core capsule flows pass; one UI overlay bug found preventing reliable click on capsule-custom-apply and capsule-remove on 430x900 viewport (bottom-tab-bar intercepts pointer events at the bottom of CapsuleSheet).

ui_bugs.issue: On viewport 430x900 the bottom navigation (BottomTabBar) overlaps and intercepts pointer events for the lower part of the time-capsule sheet. Buttons [data-testid='capsule-custom-apply'] and [data-testid='capsule-remove'] are visually overlapped by the bottom-tab-bar and cannot be clicked reliably (Playwright reports pointer events intercepted by bottom-tab-bar; even with the modal backdrop at z-50 vs nav at z-30, the rendered tab bar shows through and intercepts clicks — suggests an unwanted stacking context above the modal or insufficient bottom padding on the sheet).

issues: Modal backdrop (rgba 0.55, z-50) does NOT visually cover the bottom-tab-bar — bottom navigation is still bright/visible while modal is open. Likely cause: a stacking context promotes bottom-tab-bar above the z-50 modal, OR the sheet/backdrop should add bottom padding equal to tab-bar height to avoid overlap.

action_items: Fix CapsuleSheet stacking: ensure modal backdrop (z-50) renders ABOVE BottomTabBar (z-30). Either bump CapsuleSheet z-index to z-[60] / z-[70], OR hide BottomTabBar when any modal/sheet is open, OR add bottom-padding (~90px or pb-[90px]) to the sheet's inner content so its bottom buttons sit above the fixed bottom-tab-bar.
After fix, ensure capsule-custom-apply and capsule-remove receive click events without needing force=True.

rca_of_the_issue: RCA: CapsuleSheet root motion.div uses `fixed inset-0 z-50`. BottomTabBar nav is `fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-30` (parent pointer-events-none; inner div pointer-events-auto). On the test viewport (430x900), the sheet's content (with pb-safe only) extends down into the same y-range occupied by the bottom-tab-bar. Although CapsuleSheet has higher z-index numerically, the bottom-tab-bar is visually rendered above the modal backdrop AND its pointer-events-auto child captures clicks on capsule-custom-apply and capsule-remove. Likely cause: a parent of BottomTabBar (or BottomTabBar itself via filter/transform/will-change) creates a stacking context that wins against the modal's z-50, OR the modal backdrop is rendered inside a container with isolation that prevents it from overlaying the nav. Reproduction: viewport 430x900 → seed pair → /messages → click capsule-btn → capsule sheet opens with bottom-tab-bar still visible and clickable below; clicking capsule-custom-apply or capsule-remove triggers Playwright 'subtree intercepts pointer events' from bottom-tab-bar. Mitigation options: (a) raise CapsuleSheet z-index to z-[60]+; (b) hide/dim BottomTabBar when any sheet/modal is open via context flag; (c) increase the sheet's bottom padding to clear the tab bar (e.g. `pb-[calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom)+96px)]`).
